arxiv-2210-08391.title: Video in 10 Bits: Few-Bit VideoQA for Efficiency and Privacy
arxiv-2210-08391.creator: Shiyuan Huang, Robinson Piramuthu, Shih-Fu Chang, Gunnar A. Sigurdsson
arxiv-2210-08391.description: Abstract In Video Question Answering (VideoQA), answering general questions about a video requires its visual information. Yet, video often contains redundant information irrelevant to the VideoQA task. For example, if the task is only to answer questions similar to “Is someone laughing in the video?”, then all other information can be discarded.

arxiv-2309-08389.title: Augmented quantization: a general approach to mixture models
arxiv-2309-08389.creator: Charlie Sire
arxiv-2309-08389.description: Abstract The estimation of mixture models is a key to understanding and visualizing the distribution of multivariate data. Most approaches to learning mixture models involve likelihoods and are not adapted to distributions with finite support or without a well-defined density function.

arxiv-2310-20169.title: Plateau borders in soap films and Gauss’ capillarity theory
arxiv-2310-20169.creator: Francesco Maggi, Michael Novack, Daniel Restrepo
arxiv-2310-20169.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Francesco Maggi, Michael Novack, Daniel Restrepo. We provide, in the setting of Gauss’ capillarity theory, a rigorous derivation of the equilibrium law for the three dimensional structures known as Plateau borders which arise in “wet” soap films and foams. A key step in our analysis is a complete measure-theoretic overhaul of the homotopic spanning condition introduced by Harrison and Pugh in the study of Plateau’s laws for two-dimensional area minimizing surfaces (“dry” soap films).

arxiv-2407-08906.title: AirSketch: Generative Motion to Sketch
arxiv-2407-08906.creator: Hui Xian Grace Lim, Xuanming Cui, Yogesh S Rawat, Ser-Nam Lim, University of Central Florida
arxiv-2407-08906.description: Abstract Illustration is a fundamental mode of human expression and communication. Certain types of motion that accompany speech can provide this illustrative mode of communication. While Augmented and Virtual Reality technologies (AR/VR) have introduced tools for producing drawings with hand motions (air drawing), they typically require costly hardware and additional digital markers, thereby limiting their accessibility and portability.

arxiv-2408-07162.title: Finite Vertex-colored Ultrahomogeneous Oriented Graphs
arxiv-2408-07162.creator: Irene Heinrich, Eda Kaja, Pascal Schweitzer
arxiv-2408-07162.description: Abstract A relational structure ℛ \mathcal{R} is ultrahomogeneous if every isomorphism of finite induced substructures of ℛ \mathcal{R} extends to an automorphism of ℛ \mathcal{R} . We classify the ultrahomogeneous finite binary relational structures with one asymmetric binary relation and arbitrarily many unary relations. In other words, we classify the finite vertex-colored oriented ultrahomogeneous graphs.

arxiv-2512-09029.creator: Jeanne Colbois, Natalia Chepiga, Shaffique Adam, Gabriel Lemarié, Nicolas Laflorencie
arxiv-2512-09029.description: Abstract Recent studies of delocalization-localization transitions in disordered quantum chains have highlighted the role of rare, chain-breaking events that favor localization, in particular for high-energy eigenstates related to many-body localization. In this context, we revisit the random-field XXZ spin-1/2 chain at zero temperature with ferromagnetic interactions, equivalent to interacting fermions or hard-core bosons in a random potential with attractive interactions.

pmc-13359084.creator: Xiaohang Peng, Hezhong Zhu, Jichen Wu, Jieqiong Ding, Binhua Luo
pmc-13359084.description: The removal of cationic dyes from wastewater remains challenging due to the trade-off between adsorption efficiency and post-treatment solid–liquid separation. pmc-13557237.description: IntroductionLow-dose oral minoxidil (LDOM) has become an increasingly used therapy for alopecia. uslaw-usc-t22-s277d43.title: 22 U.S.C. § 277d–43 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t22-s277d43.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s277d43.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 7 (International Bureaus, Congresses, Etc.); Subchapter IV (International Boundary And Water Commission). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In sections 277d–43 to 277d–46 of this title, the following definitions apply: (1) Administrator The term “Administrator” means the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency. (2) Commission The term “Commission” means the United States section.

uslaw-usc-t51-s70907.title: 51 U.S.C. § 70907 — Maintaining use through at least 2030
uslaw-usc-t51-s70907.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t51-s70907.description: United States Code, Title 51 (National And Commercial Space Programs); Chapter 709 (International Space Station). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Policy.— The Administrator shall take all necessary steps to ensure that the International Space Station remains a viable and productive facility capable of potential United States utilization through at least September 30, 2030. (b) NASA Actions.— In furtherance of the policy.
